uutiset.t: Consistently inconsistent? Ten things we've learnt about Alonso's Chelsea so far
uutiset.s: Xabi Alonso's Chelsea project is 10 Premier League games in. Here's what we've learnt so far...

uutiset.t: How 'sleeping giant' Everton are exceeding expectations
uutiset.s: Everything felt a bit gloomy at Everton after the closure of the summer transfer window. 'Disappointment' was the buzzword used by David Moyes - especially after a Deadline Day move for Folarin Balogun fell through.

uutiset.t: Seven years on from the sack at Spurs what sort of coach is Pochettino now?
uutiset.s: What Mauricio Pochettino achieved with Tottenham Hotspur in the previous decade looks even more impressive now than it did at the time. Manchester United really should have turned to the popular Argentine coach years ago.

uutiset.t: Man City have problems - is Fernandez their most obvious?
uutiset.s: Enzo Maresca is being forced to work within an unprecedented set of circumstances this season. Up until recently, his fixation on football matters served to quieten the noise around the club. But now the anomalous nature of Manchester City's situation is apparent on and off the pitch.

uutiset.t: Joshua unable to see new baby daughter until after Fury fight
uutiset.s: Anthony Joshua became a father for the second time after the birth of a daughter last weekend, although ongoing training for his fight against Tyson Fury means he is not able to see her until mid-December.

uutiset.t: Premier League talking points: Trial by Anfield as Poch begins Man Utd tenure
uutiset.s: The Premier League is back after the recent international break and the Sky Sports football writers dissect all the major talking points ahead of another busy weekend's action.

uutiset.t: Verstappen trusts F1 chiefs over plan to proceed with Middle East races
uutiset.s: Max Verstappen says he trusts Formula 1 to "make the right call" as the sport pushes on with plans to hold the final two races of the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi despite continued conflict in the Middle East.

uutiset.s: Formula 1's drivers appear to be unanimous with the prospect of V8 engine returning to the sport in the 2030s.

uutiset.t: Price hopes undisputed history could lead her to Shields showdown
uutiset.s: Lauren Price believes becoming an undisputed champion could lead her to a showdown with American star Claressa Shields.

uutiset.t: Hamilton: No trust problem with Ferrari team
uutiset.s: Lewis Hamilton has insisted there is no lack of trust between himself and his Ferrari team despite having overridden orders from the pit wall twice in recent races.

uutiset.s: Lando Norris reflects on his viral Sao Paulo GP podium, where he smashed his champagne bottle and appeared to get caught in the face by pyrotechnic sparks!

uutiset.t: Van Gerwen: I need my A-game to beat Wade at Grand Slam
uutiset.s: Michael van Gerwen believes James Wade is "in some of the best form of his life" and says he'll need to bring his "A-game" in order to win their second-round meeting at the Grand Slam of Darts.
